{{Quote|Look, someone assassinated the Bothan ambassador last night, and the Chief of Detectives wants as many of us on it as he can get.|Detective Chal Tozr|<ref name="Temp" />}}
A '''police officer''' held the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Chief of Detectives]] in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] (CSF). He lived and [[Police officer/Legends|worked]] on the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where he supervised the CSF's [[detective division]].<ref name="Temp" /> In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]'' to [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].</ref> several [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] including the [[Unidentified Bothan ambassador|Bothan]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] were [[Death/Legends|murdered]]. The Chief assigned several [[Detective/Legends|detectives]] to the case hoping to solve it quickly. He also assigned Detectives [[Chal Tozr]] and [[Gwad Raatu]] to investigate the death of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tresina Lobi]] in [[Fellowship Plaza]].<ref name="Temp" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chief of Detectives was mentioned in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]'', a novel written by [[Troy Denning]] that was published on [[November 28]], [[2006]].<ref name="Temp" />
